notes.title: Egypt Frontiers – Devlog: Major Gameplay Upgrades & Full Version Sneak Peek 🌄
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 🏺🕌
We’ve got a fresh update packed with new systems, improvements, and a glimpse into where Egypt Frontier is headed. Over the past few weeks, we’ve been focused on refining the core gameplay experience and expanding key systems that define our approach to simulation building in Ancient Egypt.
Our biggest milestone? Introducing worker management – a feature that fundamentally transforms how you build and progress. Alongside it, we’ve polished the player’s interaction with the world, improved animations, and implemented a set of long-requested quality-of-life features. And that’s not all — work on the  full version of the game is already bringing deeper production mechanics and strategic logistics.

Here’s what’s new:

Demo Update Highlights 📶⬆️

Assign Workers to Construction
 You can now assign your workers to handle construction jobs like scaffolding and temple elements. It’s a big shift that gives you more control, better flow, and brings strategy into building.
[previewyoutube=O9EF-lCHbNk;full][/previewyoutube]

Workforce Panel
 Check which workers are assigned to which stations and what tools they need – all in one clear interface.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44610865/edadcf12ead3a9837f39b9d4a1d96af455d760ff.png

Move Built Structures
 Built something in the wrong spot? No worries — you can now reposition scaffolds and production buildings without rebuilding them.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44610865/518aba1cff4ffcb1d2d12aa096488beef517732e.gif

Perk Tier System
 The perk tree now uses a tiered structure, introducing a smoother sense of progression.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44610865/986ae36ff436929499ac0f7dd83506afc181ac6c.png

Cancel Construction Plans
 Mistakes happen – now you can remove building plans before they’re completed via architect tools.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44610865/78e55c6c6ce9504b18bddeb922fd471730e8a392.gif

Improved Animations
 We’ve overhauled interaction and hand animations, making player movement feel much more natural.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44610865/cb444c4411667a8c61b285d8600a252cee1b4809.gif

Quality of Life Tweaks
🔸 Filter in build menu shows items by type
🔸 Added missing sounds for object interactions

⬇️⬇️⬇️

In the Full Version ⚠️✴️

Resource Production Buildings
 Construct resource-producing buildings to ramp up supply. Build as many as needed to increase output.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44610865/f2bd73d18209e85358bd037380835124262dc5d7.gif

Pallet-Based Logistics
 Place pallets to define delivery points for resources — plan smarter and streamline your construction flow.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44610865/467244b6029001df2481f9306e6ae153165cb51c.gif
[previewyoutube=qipUwl1mkBs;full][/previewyoutube]

Building Visibility on the Map
 All worker buildings now appear on the map for easier spatial planning.

⤵️⤵️⤵️

Try the Updated Demo ❗️🔅
We’d love for both new and returning players to jump back in and see what’s changed. Your feedback shapes the direction of development and helps us focus on what truly matters to you. Share your thoughts — we’re listening. We’ll be releasing new devlogs at the beginning of each month, sharing progress and insight into our work behind the scenes.

Thanks for being part of the journey,
The Egypt Frontier Team

notes.title: Development Update #1
notes.notes:
Welcome, builders, to the brand-new devlog.


We are now working on improving and polishing the main gameplay with various mechanics and QoL changes. One of the biggest changes includes the ability to directly shift some of the building work to the hired builders and manage them.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44610865/e6124a9459b4213fddd25e37c53a64d5c544c8ec.png"]

The basis of this system (which has already found its way into the updated demo) is the ability to quickly change assigned workers in their designated spots without having to walk back to the main table.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44610865/1490c487e48a9ad9488acc58d7afae17ba6992a5.png"]



Based on your feedback, we have also updated the audio systems used in the game, which will improve overall sound volume and quality.



All the best,

FreeMind.

notes.title: Egypt Frontiers - Demo Update
notes.notes:
Demo of Egypt Frontiers has just been updated!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44610865/b89c0ff434aa8e6af896dd0a1a1361e78c508e9b.png

We have updated the demo of Egypt Frontiers with improved performance. Depending on your machine configuration, you will see around 20-40% more FPS during gameplay. We have also removed all of the sudden FPS drops during gameplay that were reported to us. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44610865/1079c4a392a70cc2a46aadec2032cd5c6d44605e.jpg

Try it now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2402630/Egypt_Frontiers/

There are also some changes and additions to the available content. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44610865/fda5cbbdc7748f313bf7ba89de398445b3b30695.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44610865/505db912325234353a85b1b6384d9b3fcfb988c5.jpg

The main building site has been upgraded with more buildable elements and decorations. We added a new small buildable house as part of the tutorial to provide a more manageable part before tackling the main temple construction.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44610865/9552987ce95ff1695b5092b21838deef8a6b1428.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44610865/baec162b67ad0d1e5991e567f0c3e480d1432508.jpg

We are also marking a major milestone of working on the full game

More news about that will come sooner rather than later as we'll share more information about new mechanics and what you might find in the game.



If you still haven't done it, put Egypt Frontiers on your Steam wishlist:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2402630/Egypt_Frontiers/


FreeMind
